lines.t: Thus says The Lord: Beloved, this Word
Even every Volume to every Letter
Is the Word of My glory
Which I have put forth once again
A testament of My love and sacrifice
The announcement of My coming
A proclamation of truth
Revelation of who I really am
The Trumpet Call of God
So all those called and chosen may hear
And come to Me in their proper time and season
Behold, it is also a strong correction
For all those who have taken to themselves MY name and MY Word
To pollute it, a plumb line for this wicked generation
For this Word is a waving banner
An ensign to all nations
A trumpet of alarm and war
The sound of recompense and judgment
Which shall soon fall upon every nation
For I AM WHO I AM!
The Only Begotten of The Father
The One True God and Savior
The Mashiach... YAHUSHUA-YAHUWAH!
